verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions provides self-hosted CI/CD via YAML workflows compatible with GitHub Actions runners, directly enabling private/self-hosted runner execution, and community evidence confirms Gitea is commonly paired with self-hosted CI (e.g., Drone) in production. However, evidence is thin on Gitea Actions specifics like runner registration, scaling, or independent hands-on validation of Actions itself (most community praise is about Gitea core, not Actions). missing for 10: runner registration/setup docs, independent hands-on reports specifically testing Gitea Actions runners, details on scaling/multiple runners.
